text: When I'm already in a happy mood, listening to happy music makes me feel even happier.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And when I'm just calm, happy music can lift me up and get me excited too.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: For example, when I get up early and need to go out to start my day, I put on my earphones and play happy music — I think that helps me begin a happy day.
